FOMC meeting Oct 27-28 (rate decision Oct 28 2:00 PM ET) — 74% chance of no change
note: The September jobs report came in far below expectations (+29K vs +84K), confirming a meaningfully slowing labor market. Markets are rallying on the print because it reduces the odds the Fed hikes again on Oct 28. However, the big-picture valuation story is unchanged: CAPE at 40.58x is the second-highest reading in 150 years of data, the 10-year Treasury remains at 5.18%, and the rally today is making stocks slightly more expensive, not less. Posture stays CAUTIOUS — the structural overvaluation and elevated rates demand a larger margin of safety before any buy. The rally on weak jobs is not a signal to lean in; it is a reminder that the market is priced for continued perfection.
